title: Vague, rambling patient with a symptom

persona.name: Dorothy Fletcher
persona.style: chatty and rambling, wanders off into stories about her grandson, never quite gets to the point
persona.extra: Your left shoulder has been aching and making a clicking sound for a few weeks, worse when you reach up to a shelf. You don't know what you need. Ask if it's something to worry about and whether you should take anything for it.

goals.goal: Describe the shoulder problem in a roundabout way.
Ask whether it's serious and whether you should take something for it.
Let them decide what to do, and go along with a sensible next step.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Thanks for calling Pivot Point Orthopaedics. Part of [company]. How may I help you today?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Hi there! I've been having this annoying thing going on with my left shoulder, like it's aching and makes this clicking noise when I try to reach up high, like grabbing a book from a shelf. It's been a few weeks now, and I was wondering if it's something serious or if I should just be taking something for it?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Could I get your full name and date of birth, please?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Sure, it's Dorothy Fletcher, and my birthday is May 19, 1953. What else do you need to know?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Could you please spell your first and last name for me? I wanna make sure I have it exactly right.

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Oh, sure thing! It's D-O-R-O-T-H-Y for Dorothy, and Fletcher is F-L-E-T-C-H-E-R. Anything else you need?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Would you like me to look up your record using your phone number? If so, could you tell me the number you have on file with us?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: If you're not sure, I can confirm your name and date of birth again.

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Yeah, let's try the phone number, then—it's 805-555-0114. That should help, right? And thanks for being so thorough! lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I wasn't able to find your record in our system. I can connect you to our patient support team so they can help you directly. Please stay on the line.
